episodes.synopsis: Murakami Ryota's best friend, Kuroneko, died in an accident trying to prove aliens existed when they were kids. Now, a girl who looks just like her transfers into his high school. When confronted Kuroha Neko insists she isn't Kuroneko, but she ends up revealing something else even more surprising...
episodes.title: While I Wait for You

episodes.synopsis: Now that Murakami knows Kuroha is a lab-made witch on the run, he can't just leave her to fend for herself. Overcoming rejection, he manages to learn a bit more about her living situation... and her companion.
episodes.title: Witches

episodes.synopsis: Murakami learns that witches need to take "death suppressants" in order to stay alive. Can they find a way to get more pills before tragedy strikes?
episodes.title: Death Suppressants

episodes.synopsis: Having overcome the immediate death suppressant shortage issue, the witches start to settle into their lives as astronomy club members. A visit to the local onsen ends painfully for Murakami.
episodes.title: Lost Memories

episodes.synopsis: To welcome Kazumi and Kotori as members, the astronomy club goes stargazing on a mountaintop. Then Kana sees a forecast that wrecks the atmosphere.
episodes.title: Astronomical Observation

episodes.synopsis: The truth behind Kana's forecast of Kotori smiling over Neko's dead body is revealed, and Murakami has a possible lead on extending their pill supply.
episodes.title: The Reason for Her Smile

episodes.synopsis: The gang waits out the result of Kogoro's initial analysis of the pill to find out if he'll be able to copy it in time. Neko tries karaoke. Murakami and Kazumi head to Akihabara.
episodes.title: Fragments of Hope

episodes.synopsis: Murakami learns how reckless it is to act alone as he investigates the map. Meanwhile sex-obsessed Kazumi causes all kinds of awkward situations.
episodes.title: The Clue that was Left

episodes.synopsis: Lab witch Nanami and her handler are looking for #1107, but Ryota and the rest wonder whether they really have to be enemies. Couldn't they rescue her instead?
episodes.title: Fake Memories

episodes.synopsis: Kogoro is enlisted to attempt to remove the beacon from Nanami's harnest. Later on, Murakami motivates the girls to study for final exams by promising them a trip to the ocean.
episodes.title: Proof She's Alive

episodes.synopsis: Murakami's kindness is put to the test when a new witch shows up: is she friend or foe? Later, the truth about Kuroneko is finally revealed.
episodes.title: A Sudden Reunion

episodes.synopsis: The identity of #1107 and the objectives of the witch lab are revealed as Murakami and the rest work not only to save themselves, but suddenly the whole planet.
episodes.title: Witch Hunt

episodes.synopsis: Valkyria's relationships with both Ichijiku and Neko are revealed in the final episode. Will everyone make it out alive?
episodes.title: Things to Protect
